    Transporting ℤΔ along a tree isomorphism #

    An isomorphism of trees e : Δ₁ ≃ Δ₂ induces an isomorphism of their repetitions in height coordinates, (v, t) ↦ (e v, t + δ), where the constant δ matches the two-colourings ("Changing the orientation of the tree changes its repetition quiver only by the corresponding vertex shifts", periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). It commutes with translation and transports coverings.
